title: pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai
summary: The open-source context layer for AI agents. PipesHub turns your company's knowledge (Slack, Drive, Jira, GitHub, Microsoft 365 and 40+ connectors) into a permission-aware workspace that agents can search, grep, navigate and cite. MCP, SDKs and built-in agents. Self-hosted.

title: hrabanazviking/RuneForgeAI-Project-Aesir

title: sandraschi/democraft-mcp

title: Pigeon-Home/homing-pigeon
summary: Homing Pigeon is a self-hosted cloud-SI-controlled local agent and protocol. Tell your cloud SI (Grok, ChatGPT, etc.) to send signed jobs via email which then execute on your machine: Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, Windows or any container. An oracle on the host watches to ensure nothing bad or unintended occurs. Modern LLMs, meet: netcat.

title: MT25MB/Sunny

title: iDiagoValeta/localOllamaRAG

title: prathameshnium/Kusanagi-AI

title: Starlight-Unit-Studio/coreui

Completely isolated from the game backend of the Starlight Unit, the system offers its own infrastructure with DB, server stack and live browsing including a visible ghost cursor. Designed for autonomous, CPU-based cognitive research.

title: AxisWorkflow/axis
summary: The Axis Workflow - a simple, disciplined way to run real projects with AI. A folder of markdown files your Agent follows: plan, delegate, remember between sessions, verify the work. Portable across Cowork, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
